mapper.insert: INSERT INTO run (run_id, tenant_id, snapshot_id, idempotency_key, request_digest, state, attempt, fencing_token, input_payload, correlation_id, deadline_at, budget_amount, requester_id) VALUES (#{runId}::uuid, #{tenantId}::uuid, #{snapshotId}::uuid, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestDigest}, 'QUEUED', 0, 0, #{inputPayload}::jsonb, #{correlationId}, #{deadlineAt}, #{budgetAmount}, #{requesterId}::uuid) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO run_event (tenant_id, run_id, sequence_no, event_type, payload) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{runId}::uuid, 1, 'RUN_CREATED', jsonb_build_object('correlationId', #{correlationId}::text))
mapper.select: WITH notify AS ( SELECT pg_notify('run_event', json_build_object( 'tenantId', #{tenantId}::text, 'runId', #{runId}::text, 'sequenceNo', #{sequenceNo}::text)::text) ) SELECT true FROM notify
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_record (tenant_id, key_namespace, idempotency_key, request_digest, resource_type, resource_id, expires_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{namespace}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestDigest}, 'RUN', #{runId}::uuid, now() + interval '24 hours') ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, key_namespace, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO outbox_event (tenant_id, run_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, state, attempts) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{runId}::uuid, 'RUN', #{runId}::uuid, 'RUN_DISPATCH', #{payload}::jsonb, 'PENDING', 0)
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id::text, run_id, state::text, attempt, fencing_token, lease_owner, lease_expires_at, created_at FROM run WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND run_id = #{runId}::uuid
SELECT tenant_id::text, outbox_id, run_id, event_type, payload, attempts FROM outbox_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND state = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET state = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{publishedAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND outbox_id = #{outboxId}::uuid AND state = 'PENDING'
